title: The real AI race may no longer be at the frontier
slides: Is the AI frontier already irrelevant?
Open-source models now match frontier labs.
But most organizations miss which metric matters.
You can deploy near-frontier AI at fraction cost.
Stop chasing benchmarks. Focus on real deployment first.
thread_text:
1. The frontier is a mirage.

A Llama 3.1 405B runs at 2% of the cost of GPT-4 on AWS. Quality difference? Users can't tell in a blind test.

2. Open models erased the gap.

Mistral, Qwen, and Llama now score within 1–3% of Claude Opus on MMLU. The lead closed in less than 12 months.

3. You're optimizing the wrong number.

99% of teams track accuracy on benchmarks. They ignore latency, cost per query, and integration time—the real drivers of value.

4. Deploy a 90% model for 10% cost.

Run a fine-tuned 8B parameter model on your own V100. It beats GPT-4 on your specific task for $0.003 per call.

5. Try this tomorrow.

Take your single most repetitive task, feed it to a local Llama 3.1 8B, and measure accuracy vs. cost. Does marginal gain justify 50× price?
